desc: Ideation: understand that game is about adding cross-color edges until complete bipartite, total moves = |C0|*|C1| - M, first player wins iff total_moves is odd.
Parse N, M and edges, build adjacency list.
BFS/DFS to 2-color each connected component and compute (a_i, b_i) sizes for each.
Compute total_possible = sum(a_i * b_i), then remaining_moves = total_possible - M.
